image_description: A highly ornate, Gothic-style stone altar situated within a cathedral or church sanctuary. The altar features a central white marble table draped with a fringed cloth, flanked by twisted Solomonic columns and statues of saints in niches. Red floral arrangements are placed on the altar surface. The background consists of intricate stone carvings, arches, and religious iconography.
